description: This header file declares utility functions related to DHCP operations, including socket creation, message sending/receiving, data dumping, and DHCP options handling within a DHCP proxy implementation.

methods.name: dhcp_send
methods.description: Sends a DHCP message via a socket to a specified destination address.

methods.name: insert_arp_record
methods.description: Inserts an ARP record with device name, IP address, and hardware address.

methods.name: dhcp_create_socket
methods.description: Creates a DHCP socket bound to a specified port and device.

methods.name: dhcp_recvfrom_to
methods.description: Receives a DHCP message from a socket, capturing the sender and destination addresses.

methods.name: dump_data
methods.description: Outputs raw data in a formatted manner for debugging.

methods.name: dump_data_short
methods.description: Outputs a truncated or summarized version of raw data for debugging.

methods.name: dump_ip_list
methods.description: Prints a list of IP addresses.

methods.name: dump_dhcp_option
methods.description: Prints details of a DHCP option.

methods.name: dump_dhcp_option_list
methods.description: Prints a list of DHCP options.

methods.name: dump_dhcp_msg
methods.description: Prints a DHCP message along with its options.
